release_blocker: Cool closure at 167 radii, NOT CONVERGED. Report 24: the Report 23 solves violated the exact number and charge conservation rows (He up to 8x, H 2.3x, charge 34x) because the per-component step limiter clips populations separately; the least squares used distant directions through the nearly singular local-ALI front blocks (coefficient 172) and moved T in the fixed-T stage (coefficient 358); full trial steps created supercritical infrared masers (Lambda spectral radius 1.063, 1.058). Fixes: --conserve (trial projection onto the constraints), --pc-svd-floor 1e-2, --freeze-t, build 36 (Newton solve of the scattering fixed point where the local ALI stalls). Status: stage 1 (fixed T) restarted with --conserve, --pc-svd-floor 1e-2 and --freeze-t: conservation to 1e-15, three full Newton steps accepted (fixed measure 224 -> 128), then a stall at iterate 4 (full steps make supercritical masers; quarter step worse in the fixed measure); row-scaled measure 2.32 -> 2.85, not monotone; deep interior degrades; not converged. Narrowest blocker: ill-conditioned H ionization front (Report 24)

active_request_gates.name: Threaded tangent robustness
active_request_gates.scope: Build 28: the direction loop no longer opens an inactive OpenMP region around the ray-parallel lin_apply (nested team -> intermittent libgomp deadlock/SIGSEGV on macOS). Products equal build 27 to 1.2e-16; repeat of a build-27 pass reproduces to 8.5e-17.

active_request_gates.name: T continuation to the full RE row (84 and 167 radii)
active_request_gates.scope: Residual-shift homotopy R_T = R_RE - (1-lam) R_RE(start), lam 0 -> 1 in 0.25 stages, preconditioner-only T floor 1e-3; reached lam=1 at 84 (8 iterates) and 167 (8 iterates) without a retreat. The pinning homotopy (badly scaled) is preserved as a failed attempt.

active_request_gates.name: 167-radius T-released cool closure solved
active_request_gates.scope: Not converged. At lam=1 free Newton slides the H I front (d33-38) down the cool branch (5.5 -> 4.3 -> 3.7 kK), as at 84 radii; the exact coupled response at frozen populations (RE row slope ~ R_RE) explains the direction. Pseudo-transient continuation on T with split directions heats the front from 5.5, 7.9 and 10.5 kK starts, 3-5 % per iterate; the iterates are far from statistical equilibrium (GENCOOL thermal balance vs RE row disagree), so no finite-T root is established or excluded.

active_request_gates.name: 84-radius T-released cool closure solved
active_request_gates.scope: Not converged: grid-scale zig-zag at the front, then cold-branch runaway (front 2.2/1.8/2.1 kK at iterate 21, every step asking a further 10-15 %); PTC test (2 iterates) heats slowly with the RE imbalance unchanged. Stopped.

previous_release_blocker_report20: T-released cool closure: with the radiative-equilibrium row truly active, the 84-radius Newton-Krylov solve does not converge from a cold or a hot start. The coupled Newton direction points to a cool neutral layer whose ionization front (native d11/d12) falls between grid points; the evidence is consistent with that front cell having no consistent RE temperature on this grid (cold branch drives it toward T->0; frozen-J local balance at d12 net heating from 1.1 to 7.8 kK). Interpretation, not demonstrated non-existence or instability. Next: 167-radius released solve, T continuation, INC_AD/INC_ADV wind energy terms, level-dissolution derivatives.
previous_release_blocker_report22: T-released cool closure: with the complete RE row (level dissolution and INC_AD/INC_ADV included), T continuation reaches the full residual at 84 and 167 radii, but free Newton then slides the H I front layer down the cool branch toward T -> 0 on both grids. The exact coupled response at frozen populations explains the Newton direction: on the cool branch the front's RE row is ~ proportional to T (slope ~ R_RE, 5-7e-3 of the gross Lyman rate), so Newton targets a non-existent cool root. Pseudo-transient continuation (physical heating direction, split Krylov directions) moves the front hotter from 5.5, 7.9 and 10.5 kK starts at 3-5 % in T per hour-long iterate, but the iterates remain far from statistical equilibrium (CMFGEN's thermal and radiative energy balances disagree by orders of magnitude at the front), and no converged state exists. Whether the coupled front has a finite-temperature RE root (and where) is not yet established.
